bugs.description: Rotation mask off-by-one: the mask includes the last-granted client, so one client can be granted twice in a row while another keeps requesting (fairness/alternation violation).
Broken priority isolation in the masked path: multiple masked requests are granted at once, violating mutual exclusion.

description: 4-client round-robin arbiter (RoundRobin.lean semantics generalized to 4 clients); asserts mutual exclusion, no grant without request, work conservation, and round-robin alternation.
